content: 8:1-13 Sogoin wurit mian yab igour end Pol qamarei

See ye sogoin qamb ai bigau eng gagar mian yemetarari nub igoun end qemeribam eng: Git apand, in mi eng gugum qoyam. Eng, munon ger qoyamet eng wonomit igub qen big qib igoriba. A munon ger igo ger qenunget eng munon eng nonogursieriba.
Munon ger, ye mom qoyam imbi-imbi qamb yegaiar qamb at qiriner eng wo qoyam apand ue.
Ne munon ger wonomit me igub wonomi bumai qiriner eng munon eng Qenu wonou munon eng imbig igo.

End mian yab sogoin qamb eng gagar end bigari niau eng, ye ete qemerine igar: Sogoin qamb ai bigau qamb eng gagar wuri qenu apand ue, munon wurinou qugur barsiamirei. Qenu qebebi me igo, Qenu apand gari qas igo.
Git apand mi irout qenu irou qamb igoun, ne munon aib irou qamb igour. Ego qenu eng qamb igour eng mai erer qitet qiyo ag et igamari ibag eng apand.

Ue gab eng ar me qabari uter iningab igoriner. In Qenu apand gari qas igo eng ininou Tain gari eng. Mi gugum barsier eng in munangit in wonou tetemi. Ne Munon Aib eng Yisas gari, Munon inubersiau tari eng. Wo mi gugum barsier eng, in wot in igomot igoun.

Ego munon gugum mi eng me imbig igour. Qei qoan aibigau sogoin qamb wurit oabig igour eng ten ende igour. End wuri sogoin wurit wai min mian yab big igour eng wuri misir ue song ar nub ne misir soagen end igub igour.
Ego mani nub igoun eng inamar Qenu qani me irinerei. Mani me nub eng Qenu mag qurt qomon me biisitet igoun. Ne gor mani nun eng gor Qenu me inmusierinerei.
End an mom qoyametarar. An ar song at qiroari munon oau apand mein boru eng animbag wuri qomon boru oboubour.
An aibigau wurinou munai qau mor isub bugab mi nub eng imbigar. Munon ger oau apand mein eng animbag wo gor oau naget aibigaut mian yomunor eng niba.
Wo ende ebeiner eng an qanam abari wo qomon biisiteiba. Munon banam eng wo gor Munon inubersiau tari wot umb qubeiamorei.
Munon banam qei wuri misir gagam ue. End an qomon boru ende ebet wurinou oau apand eng wurit biruounon eng an qanam Munon inubersiau tari wot qomon boru obouboumon.
End mi niaut at munon banam qomon biisita gab eng wai min eng ye bo me ninei. Mom gitab igimine isi yarab qen eng uburiner. Bo at nine munon banam yegab qomon biisiteiner qamb.
